body.statement:
Let \(n\geq1\).  Let \(C\subseteq\mathbb R^n\) be convex and symmetric about the origin, and let \(f:\mathbb R^n\to[0,\infty)\) be integrable, symmetric, and have convex superlevel sets.  Then, for every \(y\in\mathbb R^n\) and \(0\leq k\leq1\),
\[
 \int_C f(x+ky)\,dx\geq \int_C f(x+y)\,dx.
\]

attestation.note: The stable DOI and theorem locator are supplied in place of a verbatim transcription; the emitted statement is the ray-monotonic integral inequality used below.

body.justification: This is the precise classical moving-set inequality used to establish strict Gaussian cube comparison.
body.gap: The cited theorem gives weak ray monotonicity; the strict bounded-cube conclusion needed here is derived separately.
body.consumer: The strict comparison lemma uses this leaf to compare unequal covariance matrices.
